concept.title: Where your trees are saved
concept.shortdesc: New trees are saved in a folder named uFTi inside your Documents folder, and they stay there if you remove the app.

conbody.p: Each workspace is one family tree file. saves your changes to that file as you go. When you make a new tree, saves it in the folder Documents\uFTi on your PC.

section.title: Find the file of a tree
section.p: Choose on the card of a tree on . It shows the name of the file of that tree.

section.title: Your pictures
section.p: The pictures that you add to a tree are saved in the folder Documents\uFTi\Media, beside your trees. They are kept in the same way.

section.title: If you remove a tree from the list
section.p: The file stays in its folder. says how to take a tree off the list, and how to open it again.

section.title: If you remove the app
section.p: Your trees are files in your own Documents folder. They are not part of the app. If you remove from your PC, your trees stay where they are.

section.title: If your Documents folder is in OneDrive
section.p: Some PCs keep the Documents folder in OneDrive. If yours does, your trees go to OneDrive with the rest of that folder.

section.title: Trees you open from somewhere else
section.p: A tree that you open from another folder stays in that folder. says what happens to it.
